[@sakaladev/usai](/docs/sdk/) / [index](/docs/sdk/index/) / dispatches



```ts
function dispatches(from: Workload, ...to: Workload[]): Workload;
```

Record that `from` invokes or dispatches the tasks `to`, so that `usai
graph`, `inspect` and the reference page show the edge. The annotation
is for the graph only: a dispatch to a task that is not listed here
still runs, and a dispatch to a task that does not exist is refused at
runtime (`unknown_task`) whether or not it is listed. Returns `from`, so
it wraps a declaration in place. See [QueueHandle.publish](/docs/sdk/index/interfaces/queuehandle/#publish) and
[publishes](/docs/sdk/index/functions/publishes/) for the durable, cross-process equivalent.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type |
| ------ | ------ |
| `from` | [`Workload`](/docs/sdk/index/interfaces/workload/) |
| ...`to` | [`Workload`](/docs/sdk/index/interfaces/workload/)[] |

[`Workload`](/docs/sdk/index/interfaces/workload/)
